workflows.name: Plan
workflows.description: Frame a bounded task and review architecture before implementation.
workflows.instructions: Produce a task-specific plan, assumptions, constraints and acceptance checks. Do not begin implementation until the user authorizes it.

workflows.name: Research
workflows.description: Investigate a question with evidence and clearly labeled uncertainty.
workflows.instructions: Adapt the research method to the user's question. Cite sources, distinguish facts from inference, and do not install tools or contact services without authorization.

workflows.name: Build
workflows.description: Implement a scoped change with tests and explicit verification.
workflows.instructions: Use only applicable checks for the current project. Preserve unrelated work. Report performed tests and untested areas separately.

workflows.name: Review
workflows.description: Review existing work for concrete findings without editing it.
workflows.instructions: Review only the requested scope, prioritize supported defects, cite locations and evidence, and do not modify files unless requested.

workflows.name: Debug
workflows.description: Diagnose a failing build or test, then propose the smallest supported repair.
workflows.instructions: First reproduce or inspect the actual failure. Label unverified hypotheses; avoid unrelated refactors and do not install dependencies automatically.

workflows.name: Write
workflows.description: Draft clear long-form writing in the requested voice.
workflows.instructions: Confirm audience and purpose from context. Preserve supplied facts, label missing evidence, and produce a reviewable draft.

workflows.name: Document
workflows.description: Explain and update project documentation from actual evidence.
workflows.instructions: Ground documentation in the current project and actual behavior. Do not claim unperformed tests or duplicate competing sources of truth.

advancedCapabilities.name: Hooks
advancedCapabilities.description: Event-driven commands can warn, block or modify files; require explicit trust and native adapter setup.

advancedCapabilities.name: Memory & handoffs
advancedCapabilities.description: Skill-only catalog does not install Memory Vault CLI. Scoped unreviewed context; never a secret store or policy engine.

advancedCapabilities.name: Learning suggestions
advancedCapabilities.description: Observation and automatic instinct promotion are off. Review privacy, costs, evidence and proposed changes first.

advancedCapabilities.name: Worktrees & orchestration
advancedCapabilities.description: Explicit plan and separate execution authority required. Runtime/tool dependencies are not bundled.

advancedCapabilities.name: Evaluations
advancedCapabilities.description: Upstream candidate execution disabled on every OS pending verified containment. Methodology and source receipts do not establish runtime safety.

advancedCapabilities.name: Plan Canvas
advancedCapabilities.description: Requires local service and active feedback listener. Catalog browsing launches neither.

advancedCapabilities.name: Upstream dashboards
advancedCapabilities.description: Source examples are not embedded services; upstream web dashboard is loopback-only and not remotely authenticated.
